meaning: Asset count and text-length minimums of a non-retail Performance Max asset group with brand guidelines off, as read from Google's Performance Max asset requirements page during the 2026-10-08 engineering review (finding R13-google-family:pmax-bulk-build-gap) and pinned here. Transcribed, not re-fetched in this environment: recheck against the page before live qualification. Image ratios and sizes, policy and duplicate-text rules stay with Google. The short-description rule (at least one DESCRIPTION of at most 60 characters) is the asset group error SHORT_DESCRIPTION_REQUIRED of the pinned Google Ads v25 Discovery document ("At least one short description asset is required for a valid asset group."); its 60-character limit is transcribed from the same requirements page and is rechecked with the rest.
